text:
brynn_cs: Quick triage from onboarding call w/ LatticeFi. After installing our web SDK they saw a burst of 429s during initial app open. UX lag for ~90s then normal.

omar_sdk: are the 429s happening on /auth/preflight or model endpoints? any Retry-After?

brynn_cs: mostly preflight. Retry-After occasionally 1, often omitted. They run a service worker + 3 tabs per user in beta.

kevin_eng: likely parallel preflight + token refresh stampede. Also their token TTL is 45s. If many tabs refresh around TTL-1 we hit per-tenant concurrency caps.

omar_sdk: suggested quick client changes: set maxConcurrentPreflights=1 for service-worker processes, add jittered backoff, and respect Retry-After when present. Example snippet: ```js
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({ preflight: { maxConcurrent: 1 }, retry: { baseMs: 300, maxMs: 3000, jitter: true, respectRetryAfter: true } });
```

rya_support: customer can't change service worker this week. Can we provide a short onboarding burst to cover the ramp?

onboard-bot: Quota change requested by rya_support for tenant lat-77: +45% burst for 3 hours (audit-id: q-2026-2107).

nina_sales: noting potential renewal risk; early beta UX matters. If >12h mitigation needed we'll offer an onboarding eng session.

kevin_eng: short-term checklist for customer: 1) reduce preflight concurrency in SDK config (if possible), 2) add jittered exponential backoff, 3) increase ephemeral TTL to 90s during ramp if feasible, 4) sync clocks on their fleet.

brynn_cs: I'll send a one-pager with the SDK snippet + leader-election pattern for service workers (single-refresh leader via BroadcastChannel) and schedule a 20-min watch at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

omar_sdk: opening INF-4120 to add metrics: tenant.lat-77.preflight_429_count and auth.refresh_storms.

onboard-bot: Ticket INF-4120 created.

rya_support: applied temporary quota bump (onboard-bot confirmed). Customer accepted 3-hour window.

nina_sales: I'll join the watch if UX still bad. Keep me posted.

brynn_cs: Action items: rya -> quota bump (done), omar -> add KB snippet and examples, kevin -> infra ticket, me -> send one-pager + watch link. Closing thread for follow-up after watch.
